title: Quadratic Sample Complexity for Strictly Replicable Realizable Learning with Unknown Marginals
abstract: arXiv:2610.26944v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Under the quantifier $\exists A\,\forall D$, where the realizable distribution and its marginal are unknown, we determine the finite-class sample-complexity exponent for strict replicability: two independent samples and one shared seed must produce identical functions. For $\varepsilon=\delta=\rho=10^{-4}$, the worst case over $|H|\le M$ is $\Theta((\log M)^2)$, without iterated logarithms. For $d\ge1$, $0<\varepsilon\le1/16$, and $0<\delta,\rho\le10^{-3}$, every randomized, possibly improper learner valid throughout an explicit anchored realizable family requires $\Omega(d^2/(\varepsilon\rho^2))$ samples. translated_title: 未知边缘分布下严格可复制可实现学习的二次样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 在量词∃A∀D的框架下，即可实现分布及其边缘分布均未知的情况下，我们确定了严格可复制性（即两个独立样本和一个共享随机种子必须产生完全相同的函数）的有限类样本复杂度指数。当ε=δ=ρ=10⁻⁴时，在|H|≤M上的最坏情况复杂度为Θ((log M)²)，且不含迭代对数项。对于d≥1、0<ε≤1/16以及0<δ,ρ≤10⁻³，任何在整个显式锚定可实现类上有效的随机学习器（即使允许非proper学习）都需要Ω(d²/(ερ²))个样本。对于完整布尔类P_d（d≥2），在相同的参数范围内，我们借助一个proper的泊松化球采样算法证明了匹配的刻画结果Θ(d²/(ερ²)+ε⁻¹log(1/δ))。此外，我们还为每个有限可测布尔类给出了显式的proper Gibbs算法上界。
tldr: 该论文首次证明，在分布及其边缘均未知的严格可复制可实现学习中，样本复杂度具有二次方下界Ω(d²/(ερ²))，并通过泊松化球采样算法为完整布尔类P_d给出了匹配的Θ(d²/(ερ²)+ε⁻¹log(1/δ))上界，完整刻画了该问题的复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a quadratic lower bound Ω(d²/(ερ²)) on sample complexity for strictly replicable realizable learning with unknown distributions and marginals, and provides a matching upper bound Θ(d²/(ερ²)+ε⁻¹log(1/δ)) for the full Boolean class P_d via a proper Poissonized ball-sampling algorithm.
